edges: Holmes instructs Watson to bring Mr Culverton Smith to see him.
Watson forces his way into Mr Culverton Smith's residence.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Holmes calls for Watson to present himself as a witness to the conversation.
Mr Culverton Smith reveals that Holmes has been sickened by the same illness that killed his nephew Victor.
Mr Culverton Smith pockets the little ivory box, removing the evidence of his crime.

edges: Dr Watson is called to tend to Sherlock Holmes, who is apparently dying.
